stackDivergence.rationale: Original source responsibilities retain actual RTL/UNO owners and contracts. Explicit disposal, borrowed UTF16 views, pointer-address cells, compiler overload witnesses and realm-local execution bind the browser host; physical native ABI/thread guarantees remain unqualified.

preservedResponsibilities: Original ComponentData getter returns an acquired Any from the genuine NamedValueCollection temporary; setter retains NamedValue/PropertyValue sequence kind, VOID removes entries, clear removes the outer property only at emptiness. Invalid existing kinds retain source release no-mutation behavior. Real UNO Any/Sequence/SequenceAsHashMap owners are used, without a host descriptor DTO or replacement factory.

Original provided-InputStream presence fast path and invalid-source handling, ReadOnly/PostData/Stream precedence and actual Reference template extraction are represented with native UNO/RTL map/stream owners. Positive URL/POST/trust/interaction opening and non-file readonly/default environment remain explicitly unported. File Content inference and exception branches are source-represented but unqualified because the actual file Content provider is missing. Complete SfxMedium/storage/filter/model/DOCX/XLSX UI acceptance remains unfinished.
omittedResponsibilities: Complete native stream/URL/locking/authentication/password and medium/storage/filter/model/DOCX/XLSX UI acceptance remain unfinished; no successful stand-ins are supplied.
OSL_ENSURE/SAL diagnostics, physical native ABI/thread/allocator domains and invalid/dangling pointers remain unqualified.
